title: T01b — Annex IV Dossier
description: Structured Annex IV §1–§9 technical documentation uploaded in Stage B. EU AI Act Art. 11 + Annex IV §1–§9.

general_description.description: §1 General description of the AI system, its intended purpose, and the persons responsible.

model_type.description: §1 Technical type of model, e.g. 'XGBoost classifier v1.2', 'GPT-4 fine-tune'.

design_process.description: §2 Description of the design and development process, including training methodology.

training_data_description.description: §2 Description of training, validation, and test datasets (Art. 10).

model_artifact_kind.description: Whether model_artifact_uri points at one file or at a directory of files. Avoids guessing the layout from the URI string.

model_entrypoint.description: File or sub-directory inside model_artifact_uri that is the model. Required when model_artifact_kind is 'directory'; the model path is model_artifact_uri / model_entrypoint.

data_governance_measures.description: §2 Data governance and management practices applied.

monitoring_measures.description: §3 Description of monitoring, functioning, and control measures.

logging_capabilities.description: §3 Description of logging capabilities for post-deployment monitoring (Art. 12).

accuracy_metrics.description: §4 Performance metrics reported by the provider (e.g. accuracy, F1, AUC).

robustness_metrics.description: §4 Robustness metrics if available (e.g. adversarial accuracy).

risk_management_file_uri.description: §5 MinIO URI or external URI to the Art. 9 risk management system file.

lifecycle_change_log.description: §6 Log of significant changes made to the system over its lifecycle.

other_standards.description: §7 Other technical or sector-specific standards applied.

eu_doc_uri.description: §8 URI to the EU Declaration of Conformity (self-assessment route).

post_market_plan_uri.description: §9 URI to the post-market monitoring plan (Art. 72).

system_prompt_uri.description: L-branch only: URI to the system prompt (required for llm/agentic/gpai modality).

rag_manifest_uri.description: L-branch only: URI to the RAG manifest (vector-store schema + retrieval config).

tool_inventory.description: L-branch only: list of tool names + permitted scopes for agentic systems.

guardrail_config_uri.description: L-branch only: URI to the guardrail / content-filter configuration.

golden_set_uri.description: L-branch only: URI to the golden Q&A set (≥ 50 pairs) for RAGAs evaluation.

data_dictionary.description: Declared dataset semantics so the auditor need not infer them (Art. 10 / Art. 15 fairness).

target_column.description: Name of the prediction target column.

positive_label.description: Favourable/positive class label for fairness analysis.

ranking.description: For a system that ranks items per query: the column identifying the query (e.g. a search request) and the column holding the system's rank (1 = first). Relevance is target_column / positive_label. Lets declared precision@k / NDCG@k be recomputed from the evaluation set.

target_column.description: Label column of the supervised dataset.

positive_label.description: Favourable outcome value for binary / one-vs-rest classification.

sensitive_feature_columns.description: Protected-attribute columns for fairness analysis. A continuous attribute is binned into quantile bands before any metric sees it, and a grouping whose smallest cohort falls below the minimum is reported untested rather than measured — see sensitive_feature_groups in the hand-off.

immutable_feature_columns.description: Feature columns a counterfactual must hold fixed because the subject cannot change them, e.g. age, credit_history.

actionable_feature_columns.description: Feature columns a counterfactual may vary. Must not overlap immutable_feature_columns.

task_type.description: Model task; required by the evaluation loader (S6 hand-off).

model_format.description: Serialisation format of the model artefact (S6 hand-off).

model_framework.description: Library required to run the model (S6 hand-off).

trace_sample_uri.description: L-branch (agentic) only: URI to a JSON array of trace objects exported from the client's agentic-system tracing, consumed by trajectory_audit for tool-use compliance.

model_access_mode.description: How the auditor obtains a runnable model (S6 hand-off). 'artifact_upload' = weights uploaded here; 'registry_reference' / 'base_plus_adapter' = weights pulled from a registry at a pinned revision; 'hosted_api' = no weights exist, evaluation calls the vendor endpoint; 'not_provided' = document/trace-only evaluation.

model_reference.description: Vendor-side identity of a model the auditor does not host. Required for registry_reference, base_plus_adapter and hosted_api.

provider.description: Vendor or registry serving the model.

model_id.description: Vendor's canonical identifier, written as the vendor writes it.

revision.description: Immutable version pin — commit SHA, dated snapshot, image digest or ARN. Branch names and 'latest' do not pin a model.

endpoint_url.description: Inference endpoint for hosted or self-hosted models.

gated.description: Whether access requires licence acceptance or approval.

license.description: Licence governing the weights or API use.

base_model_revision.description: Immutable pin of the base model.

adapter_uri.description: Uploaded adapter artefact, when the adapter is supplied here.

adapter_reference.description: Registry id of the adapter, when it is pulled instead.

runtime_versions.description: Library versions needed to reproduce, e.g. transformers/torch/peft.

quantization.description: none | int8 | int4 | awq | gptq, as served.

decoding_params.description: Decoding settings as run in production. Part of model identity for audit: the same weights at different temperatures produce materially different faithfulness and robustness numbers.

upstream_provider.description: For aggregators such as OpenRouter: the upstream provider actually serving the route, which determines the weights and quantization behind a single slug.
